purpose: Exact autonomous finite-window domain-wall removal and a record of initial defect count; test limits of developmental interpretation.
design_disclosure: Equations and bounds derived first. A half-line Bessel reconnaissance grid at dimensionless times [4,8], [8,16], [16,32] was inspected before freezing. No finite D2 production run preceded this card. This is not a blind discovery or an empirical holdout.

family.initial_state: system I/2^n; bath vacuum; inert reference R labels initial defect count K
family.orientation: first physical spin is a fair conserved orientation; no chosen absolute direction

controls: Remove only system-bath edge: same dimension, preparation, onsite energies, bath and system hopping; compare means AND energy variances, no memory-only attribution.
Bath maximally mixed, system maximally mixed: stationary global state, no new order or count record. This changes preparation energy and entropy and is not energy matched.

Apply a diagonal staggered bath phase at window start: same current system state and count record, different future organization; report coherent intervention, mean work, and variance change. This is a bath-memory witness, not memory-dependent regulation.

Flip physical final spin once at window start and continue without resetting bath; report injected work and exact expected-wall union bound, not Gaussian determinant after a non-number-conserving kick.
Small bath L=1: retain recurrence rather than selecting only the best Rabi-transfer instant.
Global-flip symmetry and physical-to-wall basis equivalence checked independently on small full Hilbert spaces.
record: For initial K, Q=K is conserved; N_B=K-N_wall. Guess K from N_B. Record error equals failure to have all system walls absent. This is a collective reservoir readout, not an emergent observer.
verification: Analytic uniform bounds plus small full physical-spin matrices and a separately tasked AI critic. Review within this Work run is not external RAI execution or human peer review.
time: Fixed total H for each undisturbed run; external Schrodinger parameter supplied. No physical internal clock is claimed. Diagnostic kicks are explicitly timed interventions.
physical_acceptance: Requires an independently specified extra GRUT restriction and prediction beyond standard quantum spin transport/cooling. No such restriction is currently supplied.
strict_target_free_gate: Not met by symmetry alone. Preferred alignment class, bath vacuum, interface, scales and readout are supplied inputs; report a bounded partial construction if these remain.
termination: Run only the listed family and controls. Publish all outcomes including failed interpretations. No Candidate 1 changes, larger cosmology run, merge, release, or observer/consciousness claim.
